# Anthiel

> A collective of software engineers based in Batam & Jakarta, Indonesia. We help founders go from 0 → 1 with a small, senior engineering team.

- Site: https://an-thiel.com/
- Contact: hi@an-thiel.com
- Location: Batam & Jakarta, Indonesia
- Languages: English (/), Bahasa Indonesia (/id), Simplified Chinese (/zh)

- [Home (EN)](https://an-thiel.com/): Intro, selected work, FAQ, and contact
- [Home (ID)](https://an-thiel.com/id): Beranda dalam Bahasa Indonesia
- [Home (ZH)](https://an-thiel.com/zh): 简体中文首页

## Local focus

Anthiel serves founders and teams in Batam and Jakarta, Indonesia — including software development for local products such as Batam Today (batamtoday.com).
